messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: increased 5xx error rate from canary cluster 'inference-eu-canary'. Observed crashlooping pods and HPA surge. Paging oncall.

devon: seeing ~3% of prod traffic hitting the canary, 503/504 spike starting 2m ago. Investigating logs.

samir: I rolled the canary from rs/inference-canary-v12 -> v13 ~5m ago. v13 changed init container that fetches model shards and refactored env var MODEL_STORE_PATH.

ashok: grabbing pod logs now.```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-canary
kubectl -n prod logs inference-canary-7f8d9 init
```

maria: init container failing with `sh: 1: cannot create /models/slice.lock: Read-only file system` -> the new init writes to an ephemeral path that isn't mounted in the canary pod spec.

devon: that explains crashloop. But HPA is also scaling aggressively: targetCPU 50%, minReplicas 2, max 50 -> got to 30 pods and many Pending due to node pressure.

jordan-sre: we're also in the middle of a scheduled node drain for eu-spot maintenance (kubeadm -> taint/cordon). That's increasing pending pods and causing evictions. Combined with failed init this caused a 503 spike.

anna-oncall: customer-facing impact? any pages from customers?

maria: alerting/graph shows 5xx spike in EU region, API error rate up ~3% of total, latency up for model endpoints. No active support tickets yet.

samir: proposals: 1) flip feature flag `canary-pulse` off (kill-switch) to stop routing traffic to canary; 2) pause rollout and scale down v13 replicaset; 3) immediate rollback to v12. I prefer feature flag + rollback.

devon: agreed. I'll flip the FF first so we stop customer impact quickly.

deploy-bot: exec: curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/flags/canary-pulse -d '{"enabled":false}' --write-out '%{http_code}' -s -o /dev/null -> 200

devon: :white_check_mark: feature flag off. Traffic to canary should drop to 0 in the next 10s.

maria: verifying logs... 30s after flag flip we see no new requests to canary pods, new requests are hitting stable. Error rate dropping.

ashok: I'll scale down the v13 replicaset while we stabilize:```
kubectl -n prod scale rs/inference-canary-v13 --replicas=0
```

samir: also patching the initContainer env and volumeMount on v13, but we should not redeploy until we validate. Patch command (for later):```
kubectl -n prod patch rs/inference-canary-v13 --type='json' -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/initContainers/0/volumeMounts/0/mountPath","value":"/models"} ]'
```

jordan-sre: because node drain is ongoing, let's raise node capacity or postpone remaining maintenance. I'm contacting infra to pause the maintenance.

infra-oncall (via DM): paused node drain for eu-spot pool, existing cordons will be reverted in 5m.

anna-oncall: handoff note for followup: check restart count, ensure v13 stays at 0 replicas until validated, confirm HPA minReplicas set to sane default.

devon: we've cut customer impact; last spike normalized ~4m after mitigation. Current action items: samir will prepare a patch for the init container mount, maria will run a local canary in staging, jordan will coordinate node maintenance pause, ashok will open a rollback PR note for v12 if needed.

samir: opening PR now and adding thorough e2e for init container writeable paths.

maria: filing an incident postmortem stub and customer impact assessment: 3% of requests in EU saw 5xx between 09:12-09:18 UTC, estimated affected users <1k, no data loss.

devon: if anyone needs to take this after handoff, paging is now to anna-oncall; I'm going offline for the shift change.

anna-oncall: ack, taking over. Patch / rollback timeline and status posted to this thread. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated - routing kill-switch applied, v13 scaled to 0, node maintenance paused. Severity: SEV3. Postmortem assigned to samir + maria.
